# sklearn-morpho

> Unified Python library for mathematical morphology classifiers in scikit-learn.

## Core Features
- Implements Morphological Perceptron classifiers: l-DEP, r-DEP, DEP, and basic Dilation/Erosion units.
- Built-in scikit-learn compatible Estimators and Transformers API.
- Integrated DCCP (Discipline Convex-Concave Programming) solver support via `cvxpy` (https://pypi.org/project/cvxpy/) and an optional `dccp` (https://pypi.org/project/dccp/) Python module.

## Key Documentation & Links
- [Documentation](https://d-002.github.io/sklearn-morpho/docs): Main API reference and usage guides.
- [PyPI Package](https://pypi.org/project/sklearn-morpho/): Official releases and installation parameters.
- [Jupyter Examples](https://github.com/d-002/sklearn-morpho/tree/master/MREs): Minimal reproducible examples.

## Minimal Code Example

```python
from sklearn.datasets import make_moons
from sklearn_morpho.classifiers.ldep import LDEP

X, y = make_moons()

ldep = LDEP()
ldep.fit(X, y)
predictions = ldep.predict(X)
```
